capabilities.title: Go adapter, structural and honest about a missing toolchain
Python adapter
Adapter contract and the conformance suite
capabilities.description: Every adapter must pass it - provenance on every claim, portable paths, honest evidence status, byte-identical determinism.

capabilities.title: TypeScript and JavaScript adapter with import-graph evidence linking
Machine-checked constraints - forbid-import, forbid-file, require-test
Token-bounded context pack with a reason per file
Semantic diff between two surface documents
Drift, stale claims and unproven behaviour as health findings
Bounded impact map for a set of changed paths
The derivation behind a confidence score, recomputed from the document
Human declarations that override inference, scope the scan and set granularity
Git-aware file discovery that never follows a symlink out of the project
Detect, extract, merge, declare, score, emit
capabilities.description: The single orchestration that turns adapter claims and human declarations into a validated document.

capabilities.title: surface context
surface diff
surface doctor
surface impact
surface init
surface inspect
surface map
surface report
Argument parsing, output and the command table
surface verify
surface why
run
The only code path that executes a project command
capabilities.description: Runs a command only if it already exists in the document, from a directory physically inside the project.

capabilities.title: Read-only MCP tools - impact, context, diff
Read-only MCP tools - overview, find, constraints, health
The stdio MCP server
surface_verify, double-gated execution over MCP
capabilities.description: Requires PROJECT_SURFACE_ALLOW_EXEC=1 and a command id that already exists in the document.

capabilities.title: Golden fixture snapshots and their update script
Secret redaction for every captured command output
The project-surface/v1 schema and its validator
capabilities.description: JSON Schema for the surface document, embedded into core and checked against spec/v1 in CI.

capabilities.title: Computed confidence with tier floors, corroboration and single-step promotion
Fingerprint-anchored freshness that does not self-heal
Deterministic identifiers that survive rescans and renames

constraints.rule: Every capability in core has linked evidence.
This package is ESM. Use import syntax and include file extensions in relative imports.
Golden snapshots under fixtures/ are regenerated with npm run fixtures:update and reviewed as a diff, never edited by hand.
No .env file or private key is committed.
Core makes no network calls and never writes to source files.
Environment variable names are surfaced; values are never read or stored.
Use npm to install and run scripts in this project.
constraints.rationale: Detected from package-lock.json. Mixing package managers produces conflicting lockfiles.

constraints.rule: Only packages/core/src/evidence/runner.ts and packages/core/src/git/git.ts may spawn a process. Adapters propose commands; they never run them.
constraints.rationale: One spawn site for project commands and one for read-only git queries is auditable. A third is not.

constraints.rule: Every terminal transcript in README.md and docs/ is copied from a real run.

risks.reason: Every consumer validates against it. A change is a format change and must be reflected in SPEC.md and the embedded module.
CI workflow changes affect every future build and may hold credentials.
The execution boundary. Changes here decide what an adversarial prompt can make the tool run.
The only filter between captured command output and the committed document.
